name: 36265 · Jacksonville, AL
findings: ZIP 36265 (Jacksonville) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36265 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
